shot.camera: full-frame cinema camera, 50mm prime lens, T2.0
shot.movement: extremely slow, almost imperceptible 1% dolly push-in, no shake
shot.focus: microphone razor sharp, mountains softly out of focus, shallow depth of field
shot.duration: 10 seconds, designed as a seamless loop

scene.location: edge of a mirror-calm alpine mountain lake
scene.background: huge snow-capped mountains with natural rock formations and atmospheric haze, layered depth
scene.mist: thin morning fog drifting very slowly over the lake surface, soft volumetric sunlight passing through it
scene.water: crystal-clear reflections with tiny natural ripple distortions
scene.vegetation: distant pine trees moving almost imperceptibly in the morning wind
scene.particles: tiny dust motes catching the low sunlight

subject.object: premium matte-black studio condenser microphone on a small round desk stand
subject.position: centered, slightly below the middle of the frame
subject.details: realistic brushed metal, fine woven mesh grille, subtle reflections, tiny surface imperfections, physically accurate proportions, warm golden sunrise rim light on its right edge

effect.element: a very subtle glowing cyan-blue sine waveform floating in front of the microphone
effect.behavior: gently pulsing like a calm voice visualization, soft volumetric glow, faint cyan light spill on the microphone body and the water
effect.restraint: extremely subtle and elegant, never dominant, no neon, not a UI overlay

style.look: photorealistic real camera footage, luxury technology commercial filmed in the Alps
style.lighting: natural sunrise light, golden highlights, cool blue mountain shadows, natural HDR exposure, soft filmic contrast
style.grading: premium cinematic color grade, slightly desaturated, deep blue shadows, warm golden highlights
style.motion: everything moves almost invisibly, calm, peaceful, premium

negative_prompt: illustration, 3D render, CGI look, cartoon, low-poly, vector art, neon, excessive bloom, oversaturated colors, flat lighting, text, logo, watermark, UI elements, people, animals, camera shake, fast motion, drone shot
_usage: Coller les sections shot→style dans le champ prompt de Kling (mode Professional, 10 s, 16:9) et negative_prompt dans le champ negative. Pour une boucle parfaite : générer d'abord l'image fixe (sans 'effect'), puis image-to-video avec la même image en frame de début et de fin. Pour l'app, préférer la version sans 'effect' et laisser app-background.html dessiner l'onde en direct.
